paragraphs.source_en: The Mōri still showed no sign of taking the field, and more and more men in the Western Army were trimming their sails to the wind. paragraphs.source_en: News of the Western Army’s retreat drove the Eastern Army to advance still faster. War is forever interwoven with individual destinies, changing without cease, irresistible as a gale or a flood. Yet neither those retreating nor those advancing had leisure to reflect on this. The situation shifted dramatically, and the two sides came to face each other.
